`main.tscn` now has a `ScoreLabel` Label as a direct child of `Main`, with text "Score: 0" and position (16, 16). I haven't opened it in Godot to confirm the position loads as (16, 16).

The `add_node` tool added the label and saved the scene, but it dropped the position. I added `offset_left = 16.0` and `offset_top = 16.0` to the file by hand. Godot stores a Control's position as offsets, so these should read back as (16, 16). I left out `offset_right` and `offset_bottom`, so the label sizes itself to its text when loaded.

I created no other files.
